verdict.rationale: Wise's docs extensively document international payments in 40+ currencies, multi-currency account balances in 56 currencies, mid-market rate locking, and 'no hidden fees' messaging, directly matching the finance-lead story (wise-docs-2,3,8,10,12,25). Community evidence discusses account-detail change friction and an account block case, but these concern account continuity/business verification, not the transparent-fee or international-payment mechanics themselves, so they don't concretely contradict this specific axis. Missing for 10: independent verification of actual fee transparency in practice (e.g., third-party fee audits) and more detail on how fees are disclosed per transaction.
